progression.difficulty_limit_note: Maximum world difficulty 100 is configured in /Script/RunDifficultySystem.RunDifficultyDeveloperSettings. Menu user modifiers are separate values from 0 to 75; preserve custom values.
progression.capability_note: The save stores stage and section indices. Individual mission choice is editable only when the game has serialized CurrentManualMission. Changing the saved cursor does not teleport the character or change bPlayerStartedMission.

inventory_layout.note: Serialized preset array sizes; usable slots may be gated by progression. RightHand index is an alternate weapon index, not a distinct two-handed enum.

provenance.description_note: No extracted artwork or localization. Original geometric icons and technical aliases.
